reviews.author: Showla Terrazas
reviews.text: They were above and beyond outstanding. My bmw was finished in a timely manner, way sooner then what was expected. Pricing was amazing and if I have any car troubles I will be back. Bmw service department will never see me there again after the great care let’s go automotive and friendly service gave me

reviews.author: Mark Ceruolo
reviews.text: Becki and the team at Let’s Go Automotive were excellent to work with. After my truck was looked at by the Chevrolet dealership and they couldn’t identify the issue, the team here was able to quickly diagnose the problem and get me real answers right away. Communication throughout the process was great. They kept me informed and made sure I understood exactly what was going on with the vehicle. What really stood out was the level of service. While I was there, the owner even came out personally and helped diagnose a separate issue with my truck on the spot. That kind of hands-on attention and willingness to help says a lot about how they run their business. Overall, a very professional and knowledgeable shop. I highly recommend Becki and the entire team at Let’s Go Automotive to anyone looking for honest and reliable service.

reviews.author: James Endlekofer
reviews.text: Leaving an honest review: I bought my 2009 jeep srt to this place for a tune and a transmission fluid change just a pan drop ( I had the pan dropped down from the vehicle and off for them and I supplied the fluid) and they are telling me it took the 1.5 hours to just put the pan up pretty ridiculous) and then when I called them out on it they tried telling me they had to do all this extra stuff like rescan etc. sorry to tell you that doesn’t have to be done not looking for anything free just looking for a honest and fair place. The 2 stars goes to the tune that they did on it that came out awesome they didn’t get the extra star to make it 3 just because I haven’t received any video of it on the dyno and the pulls that I been asking for to just have for myself. Been through plenty of performance shops got plenty of things tuned and everytime I walked into a place they had videos and everything pulled up for me and everything sent to me without me asking that what makes someone feel at home especially when it comes to performance vehicles. Since I can’t reply to the review this is how I’m doing it by editing it: not saying your out to screw anyone yes one hole was stripped on my bill it’s says 70 bucks for helicoil spark plug thread chaser and then the labor just states for the transmission pan install that’s why im stating 1.5 hours for a transmission pan install when the pan was off for you guys is outrageous and then I thought the 70 bucks was for the rethread labor and the part I can get that part for 20 to 30 bucks online if I wanted so all I’m saying is your not out to screw anyone nothing just makes sense make your bills make sense for the customers.

reviews.text: Everyone is very knowledgeable and more than willing to address your needs. They are the place to go with performance mods , in my case my Mustang. I will be back.

reviews.author: Ivan Sweatt
reviews.text: Every time I use "Let's Go Automotive" in Socastee, aka Myrtle Beach, South Carolina I am more and more impressed. 4 months ago I used them for quite a few maintenance and repair items on my 2015 RAM ECODIESEL LARIMIE 4x4. I was super impressed then, but I am even more so now. This team of Automotive Experts and Master Mechanics maintain and repair everything from Race Cars to Trucks regardless of Brand! I normally back my truck into my driveway, but I pulled it in to park it recently. The next day when I came out I noticed what I thought was a huge condensation patch of wetness. It wasn't condensation but a substantial coolant leak. I immediately took it to Let's Go. They did their thing, pressurized test I think. They found a leaking EGR COOLER, which habitually goes bad on the RAM. When I took it in to be repaired this team repaired it in less time than they told me it would take. Great work at a reasonable price (much better than the dealers price) and a fast turnaround. It just doesn't get any better. I am a fan and will be a return customer time and time again. Great Job Joey and Team!

reviews.author: Michele Pappagallo
reviews.text: My husband dropped our 2016 GMC Sierra SLT off recently for a diagnosis. We were told there was a $125 charge for the diagnosis, which we agreed to. Let's Go gave us a quote for repairs that was quite a bit higher than the local GMC dealer had previously quoted, so we told them not to do any repairs, and that we would be there shortly to pick it up. A few minutes later, we received a call from Let's Go stating that they had installed new plugs in our truck at a cost of $456. They stated they had to do that in order to make a diagnosis. My husband told them we did not authorize that work, so they stated they would remove them before we picked it up. When he picked up the truck, he noticed it was running worse than when we dropped it off, but he drove it straight to the GMC dealer and dropped it off. The GMC dealer called us a short time later to tell us that two of the plug wires had not been reattached. I am not sure how this was missed by Let's Go, but it did not give us a great feeling about our experience with them. This is in no way a false review....It is our honest opinion of the service we received from this business. .....EDITED FOR CLARITY after seeing the reply from Let's Go Automotive - I never said we paid for the spark plugs. In my review, it states that they were removed before we picked up the truck since we had not authorized that work to be done. In addition, the truck was obviously not running well when we dropped it off due to the lifter issue, however, it was running much worse when we picked it up due to the fact that Let's Go apparently didn't reattach two of the spark plug wires when they put everything back together. While I realize that everyone is human, missing not one, but TWO spark plug wires seems excessive. When we dropped off the truck, we were told the diagnostic fee was $125. Now, Let's Go is claiming we should have been charged more. I guess I don't understand why they quoted us a diagnostic price if they weren't willing to stand by their own figures. This is by no means a FALSE review as Let's Go has claimed in their reply.....We are regular people that dropped off a vehicle for a diagnosis. It is unfortunate that Let's Go Automotive feels the need to claim that I am not being honest since I have only stated exactly what our experience was with their business.

reviews.text: I was referred here by my friends. I was having major problems with my car that I had taken to multiple shops and Joey was very helpful and fixed it up with no problems. He kept me updated the entire time, and if things went unexpected, he told me right away. They do good work at Let’s Go and they will definitely be getting all of my business henceforth. I would refer every person I could to Let’s Go!

reviews.author: STEVE PHILLIPS
reviews.text: Joey and the crew went way above what was expected of them!!! Great place to do business with. Fair prices and great service. I can’t recommend them enough. Thanks guys for my resent engine rebuild it runs great!!!!!

reviews.author: Chevis Geihsler
reviews.text: We had some major front end repairs come up due to some poorly-timed lack of maintenance and running over a road hazard. They took great care of us and even offer in-house financing if you’re in a bind. Highly recommended shop. Very professional, super courteous.

reviews.author: Peter Woloszyn
reviews.text: I came in to Let’s Go to have a pre-purchase inspection done before buying a used car. They were super accommodating, very friendly and very professional. I wish I caught the tech’s name who did the inspection, because he was great. Their pricing was pretty good, as well. I’d for sure recommend them to friends and family. Lets goooooo!

reviews.author: Kristy Jordan
reviews.text: I will highly recommend this company to everyone. Everyone there went above and beyond and the turn around time was amazing.

reviews.author: max nichole
reviews.text: I had a really bad experience at the jiffy lube on church st. There mechanic messed with my car and decided to unplug my camshaft sensor so I’d have to pay to replace that and 2 other parts. Well, I’m glad I came here to have them check. Took a quick look at it and instantly knew what was up. Jiffy lube unplugged and broke it so multiple codes would come up. This business was upfront and honest and really worked with me. As someone who has crippling anxiety this is where you want to go. As a 19 year old female by myself they never once tried to take advantage of that. I felt comfortable and taken care of. The environment is also awesome, everyone inside is super sweet and even offered me coffee lol. Amazing business, and my new mechanic.

reviews.author: Giuseppe Scotto
reviews.text: Joey and the guys did a great job on my 00 audi s4, installed a full performance exhaust and did some maintenance. very knowledgeable and are great people to talk to. very clean shop and car came back in perfect condition. appreciate everything guys

reviews.author: Jack Martin
reviews.text: I am very pleased with the thorough work they did to my car and checked it out to make sure I was safe on the road. I dropped mine off thinking it was one thing and it was something completely different. They called and let me know I didn't need the parts to fix it and so many shops would have done it anyway to get your money. This will be my new go to place. Very reasonable prices as well !

reviews.author: Christopher Blymyer
reviews.text: The guys at the shop know exactly what they’re doing and love go fast cars just as much as anyone bringing their car to them. They took care of my Shelby on the Dyno and made some great power. Absolutely couldn’t have gone any smoother. Give these guys a call. I drove from Columbia SC to Myrtle Beach then drove back same day after the tune. Give them your toys and you won’t be disappointed. Thanks guys, I’ll be back with more powaaa

reviews.author: Jay Jay
reviews.text: Had my vehicle towed there due to a fuel leak. Went to pick it and the owner Joey didn't charge me. Was only a loose fuel line that the previous owner had just installed before I had purchased. Needless to say I was much appreciative and had since taken my (vehicles) there for anything from a simple oil change to putting in a new rack and pinion. I had also had a strut go out that was installed at Let's Go. I took vehicle back and was fixed under warranty including labor. Once again I cant complain there. I will not bring my vehicles anywhere else, you cant beat the costumer service the guarantee of work!

reviews.author: ivan cordero
reviews.text: Joey and his team were incredible! Had them install long tube headers on my Ford Mustang GT, and kept me in the loop through it all. If you’re looking for a great educated team, Let’s Go Performance is where to go! Definitely will be coming back!

reviews.author: Mike Lecker
reviews.text: Amazing service. Drove over 10 hours to have joey tune my car and was worth the trip. Never though the car can run this smooth nor pull as hard as it does. He even cooked me dinner. Awesome guy and crew

reviews.author: Darwin Stinson
reviews.text: Took my car in to get a few things done. Turns out I needed a new timing belt and tensioner as well. Joey ordered the parts and still had everything done in just over a 24 hour period! Fast reliable service! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Vincent Gramuglia
reviews.text: Had to take my car somewhere else after spending 13,000 on just labor for engine work .installed johnson Lifters wrong put same size push rods on all lifters and didnt help or offer solutions .They place i took to check realized right away when I explained what was done what was wrong each lifter needed to be measured and push rods made to specs

reviews.author: Patrick Antonino
reviews.text: These guys are awesome. Live and breath horsepower. Just added long tube headers to my Jeep SRT and I couldn’t be more happy. Sounds badass and picked up some pretty good horsepower. Win win. The place to go for your horsepower needs.

reviews.author: Zachary Colbert
reviews.text: I have been taking my bmw here for awhile now and I’m very meticulous about who I let touch my car. Joey and his crew are top notch and know what they’re doing. They don’t cut corners and they have always finished my car in a timely fashion. I highly recommend!!

reviews.author: john cacaccio
reviews.text: Awesome auto performance shop! Highly recommend them! JC the mechanic was knowledgeable and professional. And Daniel shop manager very helpful!

reviews.author: CJ Johnson
reviews.text: I was looking for a place to get some performance work done on my 2017 GT350 and just happened to stumble across this place not far from my house. Man am I ever glad I found these guys! I took my GT350 to them to have Long tube headers installed and a tune. The car stock was at 424 rwhp. After the header install, exhaust work and Dyno tune it gained 55 rwhp. Now running 479.09 rwhp on pump gas! That my friends is truly amazing. Great group of people! Very knowledgeable and professional! I won't take my Shelby anywhere else from now on!

reviews.author: Don Kelley'jr
reviews.text: The ONLY place in town to take a performance car or ANY VEHICLE that needs repair or more Horsepower. Joey and his crew will get it done and in a timely fashion. Just put 1450cc injectors and a flex fuel system and all in two days and before I found these guys my car would have set for at least 2 weeks to a month before it would be ready but not here. Once they got my parts it was DONE!!!

reviews.author: Kelly
reviews.text: Great people and GREAT service and very helpful anytime I need something done to my vehicles. Would recommend to anyone who need anything done to their vehicles.

reviews.author: Rex Spiller
reviews.text: I recently purchased a 1997 Jaguar XK8 from a dealer in Atlanta. When the car arrived the finish was dull and patchy from exposure. I took it to 4 body shops trying to get it painted. No one would do it, then l came across "Let's Go" Joey inspected it and advised me not to have it painted. He wanted to buff it out and wax it instead. I left the car that day and Joey and his crew did the work the following day. Let's Go saved me thousands of dollars and my car looks terrific. I highly recommend them for any type of automotive service.

reviews.author: Jesse Ray Hicks
reviews.text: I had some air conditioning problems in my 2003 Silverado. I had the truck in two other shops 4 separate times and they could not figure out the problem. I took it to Let's Go and they diagnosed and fixed it right away. Quick turnaround had me back on the road blowing icy cold air. Standard pricing no gouging.

reviews.author: shabella
reviews.text: Got my truck to brand new status at a very reasonable price. I will definitely start shipping work to them in the future

reviews.author: Ryan Joline
reviews.text: Knowledgeable, honest, great communication and great experience. Will definitely return and highly recommend. Thank you Joey and your team.

reviews.author: Deb Roberts
reviews.text: Joey is great. The only worry I had was when I picked my truck up, my battery had to be jumped due to I needed a new one. The guy who jumped my battery didn't close the hood all the way. I traveled 4 miles down Hwy 31 at 70 mph. This could have been a disaster. I was at at stop light when the guy beside me called my attention to it. I had angels watching over me on this day.

reviews.author: Maxxyyy
reviews.text: Paid 4grand for my bmw to get fixed and had to have it towed after they “fixed” it worst experience ever. Glad I didn’t take them to court

reviews.author: Chris Califf
reviews.text: Called in and spoke with Dan. He got me right in for transmission service on my 2006 Mustang GT. Very happy with their service. Transmission shifts alot smoother. Thanks again.

reviews.author: Cindi Morgan
reviews.text: The go to place for an oil change!! They also do other car repairs. Joey and his whole staff is awesome!! They are honest & their work is top notch!!! We have gone for each oil change since moving here 2 years ago, haven't had any other problems, but Joey & staff can do all types of car maintenance!!!

reviews.author: jason dupuis
reviews.text: Very expensive. I needed my Procharger rebuilt on my 99 Cobra so they sent it off to get it rebuilt in which I paid Procharger directly. They performed the job of uninstalling the head unit and reinstalling it, which it a two hour job at most. They charged me over $800.00!! Also I asked for a Quote to do an e 85 conversion on the Cobra and they came back with $ 8,500.00. I could buy a whole new engine for that much money.

reviews.author: Joe G
reviews.text: Went in to see if they could help me with my strut mounts being chewed from improper installation of my new coil overs. They urgently suggested that I could not continue to drive with how bad my strut mounts were and took my car to the garage asap. Joe, Joey and Johnny took this issue seriously and began repairing my coil over to stop eating the mounts. Johnny kicks @$$, he found out the problem and corrected it quickly. I highly suggest you try these guys out if you ever have a problem other mechanics could not fix. Lets Go gets more stars then 5 imo.

reviews.author: c v (CRV)
reviews.text: This shop is a real performance shop !!!! The team at let’s go was great and they are very polite and nice and really got my car back on the road fast

reviews.author: bigjmuscles15
reviews.text: Great! Very detailed, informative and reassuring. Fair, honest and nice as well. Clean job on my vehicle and I will be going back. Thank you Let’s Go Automotive!

reviews.author: Daniel Green
reviews.text: Such a warm and inviting place! The office staff is very knowledgeable and kind. Extremely detailed with the findings and will show it all to you. Very handy I’d say. The only men I want under my hood.

reviews.author: Nikolai Bonnkarovsky
reviews.text: Need to give a shoutout, if y'all need any work done locally on your vehicle Let's Go Automotive is the place to go to. I hydrolocked my engine on the 23rd and sadly my engine didn't make it, he(the owner) his employees helped me through every step of getting it running with the hopes of it being unharmed. Even after got the car running and heard the awful rod knock they walked me through every option available. I couldn't have asked for better service.

reviews.author: June Townsend
reviews.text: The staff is friendly and very knowledgeable. The service is is great. The mechanics are quick to diagnose and make necessary repairs without over charging. I highly recommend Let’s Go Automotive

reviews.author: Tara Morgan
reviews.text: Competitive pricing and amazing team at Let’s Go. They got my suv done in such a timely manner and I couldn’t be more happier. Thank you!

reviews.author: richie gerardi
reviews.text: Went in there today for the first time to talk to Joey about my car. I can’t wait to work with these guys and do business. What an amazing group. What an amazing shop!!

reviews.author: YK Tweek
reviews.text: Spent over 1k in expenses for a water pump, thermostat/housing replacement. A day later the check engine light appeared, new codes and temperature gauge still unchecked. A waste of money and honestly frustrating, just for my car to have more issues; and a reoccurring code!

reviews.author: Luigi Scotto
reviews.text: Found out about Joey from my cousin and must say really good reliable mechanic! 10 out of 10 would reccomend. Nice family and all around genuine people. Definitely going back if theres something wrong with my vehicle

reviews.author: Al Morgan
reviews.text: Work was performed as requested and completed sooner than expected. Becky was a pleasure to deal with and all done with a smile

reviews.author: Regina Knight
reviews.text: Horrible work don on my daughter's SUV! Left control arm bolts in tightened (among other things) , she could have had a horrible accident!! Do not go here at all!!

reviews.author: The Man
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable techs and very well equipped shop. They are very nice and honest as well. Wouldn't hesitate to send any repair there. The shop dogs are pretty awesome too.

reviews.author: Lauren Stein
reviews.text: Fast and reliable service. The staff is friendly and informative so you know your vehicle is in good hands, 100% recommend.

reviews.author: teri melendez
reviews.text: Great shop with friendly people. Did an awesome job on my ac system just in time for a hot summer. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Crazy For Nature Photography
reviews.text: Very hard workers, honest. I would send anyone to their shop. Go and see. Can’t go wrong taking your car. Certified mechanic and very nice.

reviews.author: Kaylee Bandy
reviews.text: Let’s Go is our absolute go-to for all of our automotive needs. We drive from Florence because of their service and professionalism.

reviews.author: Sandra Schmitz
reviews.text: Had to have brake line replaced and caliber replaced, and they did a good job. Very thorough and friendly will recommend.

reviews.author: RC Carrillo
reviews.text: This guys were top knotch! Very pleased with the work they did to my Honda S2000. Will let friends and family know to bring their car to him

reviews.author: Sid bender
reviews.text: Great shop, great employees and owner. Anything I've needed done they have rushed to get it done for me. Absolutely helpful shop highly recommend to anyone needing a performance shop

reviews.author: Scooter Coates
reviews.text: I always bring my car to let’s go automotive and performance for all my automotive needs. They are local, trustworthy and realiable. I would recommend them to everyone.

reviews.author: Chris Lee
reviews.text: Very clean and organized atmosphere, beyond friendly owner/workers. Knew what was wrong with my ride within minutes! Definitely coming here for any other issues I have!

reviews.author: john volpetti
reviews.text: This is the only place I would bring my car to very honest mechanics and have the best prices anywhere and great communication throughout the process.

reviews.author: Leiselle Mayfield
reviews.text: Great helpful customer service. Very professional and timely. They went out of their way to ensure I got what I needed.

reviews.author: Paulo Dos Santos
reviews.text: Did a really good job on my 5.0 got it dyno tuned and flex fuel big gains on power. For sure getting more work done with these guys they know what their doing.

reviews.author: Michael Shields
reviews.text: always amazing customer service. They know what they are doing. Don’t have to worry about overpriced services. They are very fair and always get the work done promptly.

reviews.author: Charles Young
reviews.text: They were professional and explained everything they were doing and why. I was really impressed and recommend for classic car repair to anyone needing help. Thank you.

reviews.author: Jim Nemeth
reviews.text: Quick diagnosis of the issue and a very timely repair. Great communication and made the repair as easy as possible

reviews.author: Sarah Rodriguez Delgado
reviews.text: Great! Took less time that I thought!!! 100% great job, I finally found that good mechanics I always tried to find

reviews.author: Jonathan Holmes
reviews.text: fast and reliable. joey helped me more than he really should’ve . he’s the guy to go to for your car with any issue . highly recommend going to him .

reviews.author: Vincent Di Cristofalo
reviews.text: Great operation ! Very courteous and professional, along with excellent and prompt service. I would highly recommend them to all my friends and family

reviews.author: Lynn Eckert
reviews.text: Excellent group of people very knowledgeable and very helpful! Great pricing, very clean shop and prompt service! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Frank Fuller
reviews.text: They went above and beyond to save our vacation when we broke down. So professional and more than fair on price, I highly recommend this family run shop!

reviews.author: Carey Ballard
reviews.text: Everyone is always welcoming and helpful. Always quick to explain what’s going on whether it be a simple issue or a difficult one!!

reviews.author: Nicholas Swan
reviews.text: Great service and great team went through and took care of all my concerns. Gave the care a once over and took care of all problems.

reviews.author: Beautifully Ruined
reviews.text: Amazing people there, and they will go above and beyond to help with whatever you need. Highly recommend!
